text: Welcome to Chairman Rose’s exclusive space.\nHere, nearly a thousand feet above the earth![VAR 0114(0007)]

So, you got through all of the special staff that
I had ordered to stop you.\c
I would expect nothing less of the Trainers
handpicked by Champion Leon himself.[VAR 0114(0007)]
But I am afraid it is now time for you to\ngo home.[VAR 0114(0007)]
I will not allow anyone to disturb the great\nChairman Rose![VAR 0114(0007)]

You shall be the first, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\c
If I beat you to pieces, then the Champion will
have no one to battle and will thus lose heart.\c
In that state, he will listen to anything the
chairman says![VAR 0114(0007)]

Arghhh!
This is inexcusable...\c
What was I thinking... Any Gym Challenger who’s
made it this far would be no pushover...[VAR 0114(0007)]

Under normal circumstances, I would have tried
to delay you further.\c
However, all the necessary Wishing Stars have
been collected. Do as you wish. There is nothing
to be done now.[VAR 0114(0007)]
Everything I did, I did to further the chairman’s\nown goals...[VAR 0114(0007)]
